size.value: "縦４センチメートル、横３センチメートル" (height 4cm × width 3cm) — matches DB's 3×4cm exactly

background.value: Background must be plain with no shadows visible (影が入らないこと)

validity.value: "提出の日前６か月以内に撮影されたもの" (taken within 6 months prior to the date of submission)

headwear_policy.value: "無帽で正面を向いたもの" (hatless, facing directly forward)

glasses_policy.value: Glasses frames must not obscure the eyes and must not cause light reflections; excessively thick frames are described as unsuitable

official_source_url.value: https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/applications/status/photo_info_00002.html (出入国在留管理庁 / Immigration Services Agency of Japan, Ministry of Justice)

glasses.en: Eyeglass frames must not obscure the eyes or cause glare/reflection; excessively thick frames are unsuitable.
glasses.ko: 안경테가 눈을 가리거나 빛 반사를 일으키면 안 되며, 지나치게 두꺼운 테는 부적합하다.
glasses.ja: メガネのフレームで目が隠れたり、光の反射が写り込んだりしてはならない。極端に太いフレームは不適切である。

headwear.en: Must be photographed hatless, facing directly forward.
headwear.ko: 모자를 쓰지 않고 정면을 바라본 상태로 촬영해야 한다.
headwear.ja: 無帽で正面を向いて撮影すること。

size.evidence: Official Immigration Services Agency (moj.go.jp) page states verbatim '縦４センチメートル、横３センチメートル' (vertical/height 4cm, horizontal/width 3cm), matching the DB's '3 × 4cm' exactly.
